tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind product grids, category and product pages, cart and checkout. Off-white by default.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Product cards, filter panel, cart lines and the checkout form, on top of bg.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit above a card: dropdowns, cart drawer, sticky Order Now bar, modals.

tokens.name: media-frame
tokens.usage: The very light grey square behind product photos on cards and the product page.

tokens.name: chrome-bg
tokens.usage: Dark brand zones in every theme: site header, hero banner, promo banners and footer. The logo's near-black. The only ground the logo images may sit on.

tokens.name: chrome-surface
tokens.usage: Search field, icon buttons and cards inside the dark header, hero and footer.

tokens.name: chrome-border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines inside dark zones: footer column dividers, the line under the header.

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Headings, nav links and body text on chrome-bg and chrome-surface (17.9:1 and 15.6:1).

tokens.name: on-chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text in the footer and hero subtitle, on chrome-bg and chrome-surface (7.9:1 and 6.9:1).

tokens.name: chrome-silver
tokens.usage: Brushed-silver eyebrows, wide-spaced taglines and icon strokes in dark zones, on chrome-bg and chrome-surface.

tokens.name: chrome-accent
tokens.usage: The logo's glow blue in dark zones: links, the active nav item, diagonal light streaks and the cart count, on chrome-bg and chrome-surface (8.2:1 and 7.1:1).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet blue ground for the COD/trust strip, selected filter chips and info notes. Text on it: ink, ink-muted or brand-bright.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: card outlines, dividers between list rows and the trust-strip separators. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, quantity steppers and outline buttons. At least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, product names and body copy on bg, surface, surface-raised and brand-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: specs line, delivery note, old price, captions, on bg, surface, surface-raised and brand-tint.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: The logo's brushed-silver letters. Eyebrow labels, category names in the wide spaced caps style, and icon strokes on bg and surface.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The blue of the Z in the logo, deepened enough to carry white text. Fill of the primary button and active nav icon.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (4.8:1 dark, 5.6:1 light).

tokens.name: brand-bright
tokens.usage: Electric blue for links, the selected tab, the glowing accent rules and small highlights, on bg, surface, surface-raised and brand-tint. In dark it is the logo's glow blue.

tokens.name: offer
tokens.usage: Sale and limited-offer orange, sampled from the tracker and boombox posts. Fill for the ON SALE badge and countdown pill only. Text on it: on-offer.

tokens.name: on-offer
tokens.usage: Text on an offer fill (7.5:1 dark, 6.9:1 light). Never white on orange.

tokens.name: offer-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text: the discount amount (Save ৳71, -9%), on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: In stock, order placed, delivery confirmed, as text or icon on bg and surface. Always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Out of stock, form errors, as text or icon on bg and surface. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element. 7:1+ dark, 5.8:1+ light on every surface.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section titles on the home page, product name on the product page.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Category page title, checkout step titles.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Product name on a product card (two lines max).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Wide-spaced uppercase label over headings and on category tiles, echoing the cover photo's tagline. Set in silver or brand-bright.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Cash on delivery all over Bangladesh. ঢাকার ভিতরে ১–২ দিনে ডেলিভারি।
styles.usage: Descriptions, specs, policies. Works for English and Bangla.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card spec line, captions, helper text under inputs.

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: Price on the product page and sticky order bar.

styles.name: price-sm
styles.usage: Price on product cards and in the cart.

styles.name: price-was
styles.usage: Struck-through regular price beside a sale price, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between price and old price, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Product grid gap on phones, card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gap from 768px, gap inside sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between home-page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between home-page sections from 1024px.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero top/bottom padding on desktop, footer top padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small chips. The brand is angular: keep corners tight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, category tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Product cards, drawers, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Countdown pill and filter chips only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Product card at rest; raised panels.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Hover/press on product cards and the primary button: the logo's blue rim light. One glowing thing per view.
